title: Resolving the black hole singularity
bottleneck: Classical general relativity predicts that matter collapsing inside a black hole reaches a singularity where curvature diverges and the equations break down, signaling the theory's own failure. Whether quantum gravity replaces the singularity with a bounce, a fuzzball, or something else entirely is unknown because the interior is causally cut off from observation.
why_it_blocks: The singularity is where general relativity demonstrably fails; any quantum gravity theory must say what happens there, and different answers imply radically different pictures of spacetime.
current_state: Loop quantum gravity predicts a bounce replacing the singularity, string theory's fuzzball proposal removes the horizon and singularity together, and several models predict observable gravitational-wave echoes, none yet detected. Loop quantum gravity predicts a bounce, string fuzzballs remove the horizon entirely, and some models predict gravitational-wave echoes that have not been observed.
